title: Sausage & Bean Casserole
teaser: Sausages simmered with beans in a tomato sauce — a filling one-pot dinner.
ingredients: 1 tin butter beans or cannellini beans, drained
steps: Brown the sausages in a little oil in a large pan, then remove and set aside.
Add the onion to the pan and soften for 4 minutes.
Return the sausages to the pan with the tomatoes, beans, and herbs.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has thickened. Serve with crusty bread or mash.

title: Beef Mince & Butter Bean Stew
teaser: A simple, filling stew that mostly looks after itself once it's simmering.
steps: Fry the onion and carrots in a little oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, and butter beans, adding a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the carrots are tender and the stew has thickened. Serve with bread or mash.

title: One-Pot Chicken & Chickpea Stew
teaser: A simple, warming stew that leans on tinned chickpeas and tomatoes.
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in the paprika, tomatoes, and chickpeas, adding a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the stew has thickened. Serve with bread or rice.

title: Creamy Beef Mince Stroganoff
teaser: A quicker mince twist on stroganoff, finished with a paprika soured cream sauce.
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in a little oil for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the paprika and beef stock and simmer for 8-10 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the soured cream.
Serve over rice or pasta.

title: Moroccan Lamb & Apricot Stew
teaser: Lamb mince simmered with dried apricots and warm spices for a sweet-savoury weeknight stew.
ingredients: Lamb or vegetable stock as needed
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil for 4-5 minutes.
Add the lamb mince and brown, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the cumin and cinnamon, then add the tomatoes and apricots, with a splash of stock if it looks dry.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes until thickened. Serve with couscous or flatbread.
